hyla.definition: n. the type genus of the Hylidae; tree toads
hyla.translation:
n. 雨蛙
[医] 中脑水管旁支, 副中脑水管

hyland.translation:
海兰 Wheelan的变体（人名, 爱尔兰姓氏）
海兰（人名, 英格兰姓氏）
地貌名称, 来源于中世纪英语, 含义是“高+地”（high+land）

hylas.translation: n. 雨蛙( hyla的名词复数 )

hyle.translation: [哲]实质, 原质, 原始物质

hylergography.translation: [医] 环境[对细胞]影响记录法

hylic.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to matter; material; corporeal; as, hylic
   influences.

hylicist.definition:
n. A philosopher who treats chiefly of matter; one who
   adopts or teaches hylism.

hylidae.definition: n. the amphibian family of tree frogs

hylobates lar.translation: [网络] 白掌长臂猿；白手长臂猿；白掌猿

hylobates syndactylus.translation: [网络] 合趾猿；大长臂猿；合趾长臂猿

hylobatidae.definition: n. used in some classifications for the lesser apes (gibbons and siamangs); sometimes considered a subfamily of Pongidae

hylocereus.translation: [网络] 量天尺属；三角柱属；仙人掌科三角柱属

hylomorphic.translation: a. (创造物)形成和质料构成的,形式原料说的

hylomorphism.translation: n. [哲](亚里士多德哲学中的)形式质料说(认为原始物质是万物的根源,与各种形式相结合便产生各种物体)

hylopathism.definition: n. The doctrine that matter is sentient.

hylopathist.definition: n. One who believes in hylopathism.

hylophagous.definition: a. Eating green shoots, as certain insects do.

hylotheism.definition:
n. The doctrine of belief that matter is God, or that
   there is no God except matter and the universe; pantheism. See
   Materialism.

hylotheist.definition: n. One who believes in hylotheism.

hylotropic.translation: a. 从一态变另一态不改其构成物原比例的,保组变相的

hylozoic.definition: a. Of or pertaining to hylozoism.

hylozoism.definition:
n. The doctrine that matter possesses a species of life and
   sensation, or that matter and life are inseparable.
hylozoism.translation:
n. 万物有生论
[医] 万物有生论

hylozoist.translation: n. 万物有生命论；物活论 (hylozoism的变形)

hylton.translation: n. (Hylton)人名；(英)希尔顿；(西)伊尔顿
